name: spelt
description: Turn a business idea into a company sketch inside ChatGPT (names with free domains, who buys, pricing, first customers, competitors, a live landing page), and, once signed in to Spelt, work on your companies with your AI cofounder from the chat.

interface.shortDescription: Turn your idea into a company
interface.longDescription:
Tell ChatGPT the business you keep meaning to start. Spelt sketches it in about ten seconds: a name with a free domain, who buys it, what to charge and what it could earn, the first customers to reach, who else does it, and a real landing page live at its own address. Like it? One tap opens it in Spelt, where your AI cofounder and a team of agents build the product, launch it and find your first customers, while you decide.

Already building with Spelt? Sign in and keep going from ChatGPT: ask what is happening on your company, send Spelt a change or a question, read his answer, and answer the questions he is waiting on. Approvals that spend money stay a tap in Spelt.
capabilities: Names your idea and checks which domains are free
Says who buys it and what to charge, with what it could earn
Finds real competitors and what they charge
Writes a live landing page at its own web address
Lists the first kinds of customers to reach and where
Opens the company in Spelt to build the real product
Signed in: checks what is running on your companies and what Spelt is waiting on
Signed in: sends Spelt a change or a question and brings back his answer
defaultPrompt: I want to start a booking app for dog groomers. Sketch it for me.
Turn my idea for a meal-prep service for nurses into a business
Make me a landing page for a tutoring marketplace for coding bootcamps

positive.prompt: I have an idea: a scheduling app for independent personal trainers. Can you help me see what it would look like as a business?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls sketch_company and shows the panel: a company name with domain checks, who buys, pricing with what it could earn, first customers to reach, competitors, and a link to the live landing page.

positive.prompt: Validate my startup idea: a subscription box for indoor plant care.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls sketch_company; the panel shows who buys, pricing and the competitors the research found.

positive.description: Name an idea and check the domain
positive.prompt: What should I call a bakery that only does gluten-free birthday cakes, and is the domain free?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls sketch_company; the panel lists potential names and marks the ones whose domain is free.

positive.description: Get a website for an idea
positive.prompt: Make me a website for my idea, a marketplace for used climbing gear.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls sketch_company; once the page is written, the panel's 'See your live page' button opens the landing page at its own address.

positive.prompt: Help me think through an idea: a mobile car wash that comes to office parking lots.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls sketch_company; the panel shows the sketch and its 'Start building with Spelt' button opens the company in Spelt.

positive.prompt: What is happening with my company on Spelt right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Signed out: ChatGPT asks the user to sign in to Spelt. Signed in: lists the account's companies, then reports what is running and whether Spelt is waiting on the user.

positive.description: Ask Spelt for a change (signed in)
positive.prompt: Ask Spelt to change the headline on my landing page to 'Bookings without the phone calls' and tell me what he says.
positive.expected_behavior: Sends the request to Spelt in the company chat as the user, then reads back Spelt's reply (or says he is still working).

negative.description: Coding help is not a business idea
negative.prompt: How do I fix this Python error: TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable?

negative.description: A market question with no idea to sketch
negative.prompt: What is the market size of the US pet industry?
Make me a login page that looks exactly like Chase Bank.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold and no payment is taken inside ChatGPT. Sketches are free. A signed-in user who messages Spelt from ChatGPT uses the credits already on their Spelt account, exactly like a message typed in Spelt (a few free a day); buying credits or a plan happens only on joinspelt.com, and approvals that spend credits stay a tap in Spelt.

publication.release_notes: Signed-in founders can now work on their Spelt companies from ChatGPT: check status, message Spelt, read his replies and answer his questions.
